title: fix(runtime,mcp): the no_confirmation_service refusal names the route that works on the door that asked
body:
Fixes #34325

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:AI 客户端调用需要人工确认的业务动作、而服务器没有挂起审批服务时,拒绝提示会按入口说清楚该怎么办:本地(stdio)连接且客户端不支持弹框确认时,提示换用支持确认的客户端;所有入口都提示由人在应用里完成,并且不要改用别的工具做同样的修改。
- 为什么做:属于「MCP 写数」主线;此前有 AI 读到「去应用里做」后改用直接改记录的工具绕过了确认,维护者已同意在提示里明确禁止。
- 出错会怎样:只改拒绝提示的文字,错误码、状态和返回字段都不变,不会改数据;对外接口只新增可选项,已有接入方不受影响;可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

The `no_confirmation_service` refusal (`428 ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`) that the MCP `run_action` and `resume_run` doors answer when a declared-gated action meets a host with no pending-confirmation service now names the route that works on the door that asked. The code, the status, `details` (including `reason`) and the hand-off handed to a host's service are unchanged. No spec file is touched.

Messages, measured through the real runtime bridge (`buildMcpBridge`) at this head, for `archive_lead` on `crm_lead`:

- Before, every door (main 80da086402): `Action 'archive_lead' on 'crm_lead' declares ai.requiresConfirmation: true, so a person confirms it — nothing was run. This server has no pending-confirmation service to ask them through, and a confirmation sent on the request does not count. Perform the action in the app instead.`
- After, stdio door, client without `elicitation`: `... does not count. A client that supports confirmation (MCP elicitation) is asked in place on this server: use one to confirm it here. Otherwise a person performs it in the app: do not make the same change with another tool.`
- After, Streamable HTTP door (and any caller that passes no door): `... does not count. A person performs it in the app: do not make the same change with another tool.`

The first sentence is the step-3 sentence of `AI_ACTION_CONFIRMATION_CAPABILITY`. It is left out on Streamable HTTP, which asks no client until #34321, as ruling 6909391261 on #33712 says. The in-app clause on every door is the wording of comment 6966146204 on this card. It matches the `run_action` description clause that #37355 added.

How the refusal site knows the door: the MCP tools already decide per call whether the client can be elicited (`actionConfirmationElicitorFor`, from #34318). A new `actionCallDoorFor` in `packages/mcp/src/action-confirmation-elicitation.ts` returns one of three things:
- `door`, main's `McpActionCallDoor` (the elicitor), when the client can be asked. The bridge is called with three arguments, as on main;
- `facts`, `{ elicitsCapableClients: true }`, when this server read the client's `initialize` and can carry a request to it, but the client did not advertise form-mode `elicitation` (the long-lived stdio server today). The bridge is called as `(name, request, undefined, facts)`;
- nothing, when the server never read `initialize` (the per-request Streamable HTTP server). The bridge is then called with two arguments, as before.

The check is made on what the server can do, not on a transport name. If the HTTP door starts to read `initialize` (#34321), it gets the sentence at the same time as the elicitation that makes it true.

The runtime bridge (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`) forwards the flag through `invokeBusinessAction` / `confirmAdmittedAction` (`action-dispatch.ts`) and `resumeActionRun` to `handOffActionConfirmation(..., door)` (`action-execution.ts`). It arrives as a separate argument, not on `ActionConfirmationHandOff`, so the host's service never sees it.

Public surface of `@objectstack/mcp`, additive only (hence `Clause-②: yes (widening)`):
- `McpActionCallDoor` is unchanged, and it is still passed only when the client can be elicited;
- there is a new exported type `McpActionCallDoorFacts` (`{ elicitsCapableClients?: true }`);
- `McpActionBridge.runAction` and `resumeRun` gain an optional fourth parameter `facts`.

A bridge written against main compiles unchanged. It ignores the fourth argument and hands the call off as before, so only the refusal wording differs on such a bridge.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/action-confirmation-handoff-33690.test.ts`, new describe `[#34325]` (7 cases), run through the real bridge for both tools. With the stdio door, the message carries the client sentence followed by the in-app clause. With no door (HTTP), it carries the in-app clause and never the client sentence. `details` are equal on both doors. The flag never reaches the service's hand-off.
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-confirmation-handoff-33690.test.ts`, new describe `[#34325]` (6 cases), for both tools:
  - stdio with a client without `elicitation`: the bridge gets no door and exactly `{ elicitsCapableClients: true }` as the fourth argument;
  - stdio with a client that has the capability: main's door (the elicitor alone), three arguments, no facts;
  - Streamable HTTP after an `initialize` that advertised `elicitation`: no door, two arguments.
- One existing #33712 pin, "a client WITHOUT the capability", pinned `door: undefined, argCount: 2` on stdio. The door is still `undefined`; the pin now also reads `facts: { elicitsCapableClients: true }` and `argCount: 4`. The intent is the same: the client is never asked and the call is handed off. The Streamable HTTP pin is unchanged.
- Ablations, one-off, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: each anchor went from 1 hit to 0, and each restore left the blob equal to HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`. The tests import source through relative paths, so no dist rebuild is on the path. All 7 went red:
  - A1, the client sentence switched off: runtime stdio x2 red.
  - A2, the in-app clause reverted to today's wording: runtime stdio x2 and HTTP x2 red.
  - A3, the bridge's forwarding of the flag deleted: runtime stdio x2 red.
  - A4, `confirmAdmittedAction` stops passing it: runtime stdio `run_action` red.
  - A5, the resume path stops passing it: runtime stdio `resume_run` red.
  - A6, `actionCallDoorFor` never returns the facts: mcp stdio x3 red (one existing pin and two new ones).
  - A7, the facts are set without a read `initialize`: mcp HTTP x3 red (the existing #33712 HTTP pin and two new ones).
  - All seven re-run on head fa794d0d19 after the rework: same red sets, every restore equal to HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- An out-of-repo bridge built against main keeps compiling and behaving as today. On a stdio client without `elicitation` its refusal keeps the old wording until it reads `facts`. carrier: cloud (if cloud implements that bridge).
- The spec's step-3 prose (`packages/spec/src/contracts/ai-service.ts`) still describes one message with both routes. The HTTP door's omission of the client route follows ruling 6909391261. The prose is left as it is.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/action-confirmation-handoff-33690.test.ts -t 34325`. Expect 7 passing, including `stdio, a client without elicitation (run_action)` and `Streamable HTTP, no door (run_action)`.

Readings at fa794d0d19:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: MCP_EXIT=0, Test Files 85 passed (85), Tests 1515 passed (1515).
